name: Kyojin Jikkenshitsu ~Hito wa Kyojin no Ko o Haramu ka!?~
original_name: 巨人実験室 ～人は巨人の子を孕むか！？～
source:
"Systematic Propagation and Growth Cycle of the Titan, and the Possibility of Interbreeding Between Human and Titan"

The team of researchers studying sexual reproduction of giants is ready to conduct human trials.
Conditions are set but there is the issue of volunteers. Nobody will come forward.

I have undertaken the task of selecting volunteers from my own unit. A rare opportunity.

For the sake of these trials, the volunteers must be very capable women. With a smile I look over the names. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE122584.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
《泰坦的系统繁殖和生长周期，以及人类与泰坦杂交的可能性》研究巨人有性生殖的研究小组已准备好进行人体试验。
条件已经定了，但还有志愿者的问题。没有人会挺身而出。

我承担了本单位选拔志愿者的任务。难得的机会。

为了进行这些试验，志愿者必须是非常有能力的女性。我微笑着看着那些名字。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE122584.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
